caveats: These are positional-context prefix measurements on a held-out, group-disjoint evaluation population. They are NOT a decomposition of the fused model and are NOT a transfer claim to any other task, corpus, or checkpoint.
Prefix tokens are prepended positionally to the text stream; the measured NLL reflects that single positional context only.

Text token position embeddings remain 0..L-1 regardless of any prefix; prefix tokens are prepended and only the available context / sequence-length changes. Text positions never shift upon prefix removal.
The zero condition is an exactly-zero encoded prefix with the same token length as the real encoded prefix; encoding zero raw input through a biased positional encoder would NOT be a zero prefix.
